mapper.sql: SELECT b.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, e.ecn_no, e.status AS ecn_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_bom_item i WHERE i.bom_id = b.id) AS item_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_bom_op o WHERE o.bom_id = b.id) AS op_count FROM mes_bom b JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = b.material_id LEFT JOIN mes_ecn e ON e.id = b.ecn_id
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT b.material_id AS "parent", i.material_id AS "child" FROM mes_bom b JOIN mes_bom_item i ON i.bom_id = b.id
